response:
I’ll run the scan and check the source to distinguish merge blockers from warnings and false positives.

**Block merge** for the confirmed date-formatting, refund-contract, and portability defects below. Most remaining findings warrant follow-up rather than blocking.

I ran `crimes scan --format json`; it returned **39 findings: 5 high, 17 medium, 17 low**. Local ordering and scores differ slightly, so the IDs and `agent_risk` values below reference **your supplied report**.

I evaluated this as an application PR against an empty baseline. Severity and agent risk inform priority; source evidence determines whether a finding blocks merge. “Ignore” means no action required for this finding in this review.

| ID | Finding | Severity | Agent risk | Category | Justification |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 00001 | Direct clock reads, `date.ts` | Medium | 0.45 | **Warn** | Highest reported agent risk; injectable time would improve boundary tests, but reading the clock does not itself establish incorrect behavior. |
| 00002 | Return shape roulette | Low | 0.44 | **Warn** | Relatively high agent risk supports clarifying the result contract. TypeScript can infer these variants; no broken caller is demonstrated. |
| 00003 | Missing agent context | Medium | 0.43 | **Warn** | Commands and conventions deserve documentation, but agent instruction files are not a prerequisite for a correct application. |
| 00004 | Scattered `"enterprise"` literal | Medium | 0.43 | **Warn** | Repetition creates maintenance risk. Confirm these occurrences share policy before centralizing them. |
| 00005 | Mixed UTC/local methods | High | 0.39 | **Block merge** | `dateLabel()` combines a UTC year with local month/day. Around year boundaries this can produce an internally inconsistent date. |
| 00006 | Duplicated navigation source | Medium | 0.39 | **Warn** | Competing labels invite stale edits, but both entries target the same destination. Establish canonical metadata. |
| 00007 | Route metadata drift | Medium | 0.39 | **Warn** | Conflicting titles and labels create user and maintenance confusion; no broken navigation is established. |
| 00008 | Option bag junk drawer | Low | 0.39 | **Ignore** | The source already declares and uses `CheckoutOptions` with all six fields required. The reported implicit-shape problem is unsupported. |
| 00009 | Timezone-unsafe parsing | Medium | 0.38 | **Warn** | The datetime without an offset uses local time and needs an explicit intended zone. The date-only ISO string parses as UTC, so the report overstates that part. |
| 00010 | `User` contract drift | High | 0.37 | **Ignore** | These are separate module-local types; one contains a smaller set of fields. Missing fields alone do not establish incompatible contracts or an actual data-flow defect. |
| 00011 | Negative flags | Low | 0.37 | **Ignore** | `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` is short and unambiguous. The score alone does not justify changing the flag API. |
| 00012 | Refund “preview” performs effects | Medium | 0.35 | **Block merge** | `calculateRefundPreview()` writes an audit and sends email. Despite medium severity, this is a concrete behavioral contract violation for callers requesting a preview. |
| 00013 | Refund authorization only in comment | Medium | 0.35 | **Block merge** | The stated owner/support policy has no corresponding guard before the refund-related effects. Encode enforcement or demonstrate an enforced calling boundary. |
| 00014 | Millisecond day arithmetic | Medium | 0.33 | **Warn** | Adding 86,400,000 ms is valid for elapsed time, but differs from “tomorrow at the same local time.” Clarify semantics before selecting a calendar operation. |
| 00015 | Hardcoded localhost URL | Medium | 0.31 | **Block merge** | `adminUrl()` always returns the developer server. The concrete portability failure outweighs the moderate agent-risk score. Supply environment configuration. |
| 00016 | Hardcoded developer path | Medium | 0.31 | **Block merge** | Schema loading depends on one developer’s checkout and otherwise returns `null`. Resolve a portable or configured schema location. |
| 00017 | Concept aliases | Medium | 0.31 | **Warn** | Document relationships between account, organization, team, and workspace. They may represent distinct concepts, so automatic renaming is unwarranted. |
| 00018 | Clock read, `api/state.ts` | Low | 0.29 | **Ignore** | `Date.now() > 0` is not a meaningful expiry check for contemporary operation. No useful clock-abstraction fix follows from this finding. |
| 00019 | Manual date concatenation | Low | 0.29 | **Block merge** | Source confirms an actual defect: `getMonth()` is emitted without adding one, yielding months `0–11`. Low scanner severity understates the incorrect output. |
| 00020 | Default locale formatting | Low | 0.29 | **Warn** | Formatting varies across hosts. Define whether the locale should come from user preferences or application configuration. |
| 00021 | Singular/plural mismatch | Low | 0.29 | **Warn** | `users` is scalar and `invoice` is an array. Rename for clarity; annotations already constrain their shapes. |
| 00022 | Orphan `/account/subscription` | Low | 0.29 | **Warn** | Confirm its intended entry point. Missing static references do not prove a route is unreachable through direct or external links. |
| 00023 | Orphan `/team` | Low | 0.29 | **Warn** | Confirm discoverability or intentional direct access; static references alone are insufficient to justify deletion. |
| 00024 | Orphan `/workspace/members` | Low | 0.29 | **Warn** | Confirm the intended navigation journey; no runtime routing failure is demonstrated. |
| 00025 | Test without assertions | Medium | 0.28 | **Warn** | This particular test calls an empty helper and protects no behavior. Replace it with an observable assertion; the finding itself establishes no production regression. |
| 00026 | `Invoice` contract drift | High | 0.37 | **Ignore** | As with `User`, the smaller local declaration is structurally compatible with a projection. No conflicting shared-field types or failing exchange are shown. |
| 00027 | Broken documentation link | Low | 0.25 | **Warn** | `docs/teams.md` links to nonexistent `setup.md`. Repair this confirmed documentation defect. |
| 00028 | Commented-out implementation | Medium | 0.24 | **Warn** | Delete stale refund code to reduce copying and maintenance risk. It does not execute. |
| 00029 | Clock reads, `billing.ts` | Medium | 0.24 | **Warn** | Inject time for reliable billing tests. Source inspection contradicts “all record/render”: clock-derived account age affects discounts and upgrade recommendations. |
| 00030 | Weak invoice assertion | Low | 0.24 | **Warn** | Truthiness of a local stub does not verify invoice generation. Assert real invoice amounts, currency, and relevant policy boundaries. |
| 00031 | Undeclared `vitest` | Low | 0.24 | **Warn** | The manifest omits the imported test dependency, undermining reproducible test execution. Declare it as a development dependency and provide a test command. |
| 00032 | Swallowed email error | Low | 0.16 | **Ignore** | The current body performs no email operation, and its constructed greeting makes the empty-body throw unreachable. Reassess error handling when actual delivery is implemented. |
| 00033 | Large invoice function | High | 0.13 | **Warn** | The mixed responsibilities merit extraction, but low agent risk and length alone do not establish a merge-blocking defect. Add meaningful coverage before refactoring. |
| 00034 | Dense TODO markers | Medium | 0.10 | **Warn** | Triage the marked unfinished behavior. Marker density is a review prompt, not proof that every marker represents a blocker. |
| 00035 | Embedded rasters in SVG | High | 0.08 | **Ignore** | Embedded raster content is valid SVG. At 592 bytes, neither material payload harm nor unacceptable rendering is demonstrated; the high severity is disproportionate. |
| 00036 | 310-line billing file | Medium | 0.07 | **Ignore** | Slightly exceeding a 300-line threshold does not independently justify restructuring. Responsibility concerns are already covered by 00033. |
| 00037 | 254 KB banner | Low | 0.05 | **Ignore** | No loading measurements, rendered dimensions, or asset budget establish a material problem. Optimize when supported by usage evidence. |
| 00038 | 32×32 raster icon | Low | 0.05 | **Ignore** | A small PNG can be appropriate. Dimensions alone do not prove that vector conversion improves quality or size. |
| 00039 | Billing TODO density | Low | 0.04 | **Ignore** | Four markers barely exceed the heuristic threshold. Review their concrete behavior rather than requiring removal to satisfy density. |

The coverage warnings also merit **warn**: excluded files were not assessed, and the superseded suppression represents a lapsed decision rather than a fix. Review the migration preview before restoring any suppression. Default-off detectors mean this is a scoped scan, not an exhaustive assurance of correctness.
